claims.statement: For immunoprecipitation, use of Protein A Mag Sepharose and Protein G Mag Sepharose is recommended.
Protein A Mag Sepharose Xtra and Protein G Mag Sepharose Xtra are intended for single use only.
The protocol recommends 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and MagRack 6; this recommendation must be read together with the same paragraph's recommendation of MagRack maxi for volumes above 1.5 mL.

values: 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and MagRack 6 should be used in the protocol. When using volumes above 1.5 mL, for example larger volumes up to 50 mL, MagRack maxi is recommended.
all_of.source_text: 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and MagRack 6 should be used in the protocol. When using volumes above 1.5 mL, for example larger volumes up to 50 mL, MagRack maxi is recommended.

claims.statement: When using volumes above 1.5 mL, for example larger volumes up to 50 mL, MagRack maxi is recommended.
Remove the magnet from the magnetic rack before adding or applying liquid.
Insert the magnet before removing liquid; use the magnetic rack with the magnet in place for each liquid removal step.

Before dispensing, make the medium slurry homogeneous by vortexing. Immediately after resuspension, pipette the required amount into the desired tube. Repeat resuspension between each pipetting from the medium slurry vial.

parameters.name: First operation
parameters.value_text: Prior to dispensing the medium slurry, make sure it is homogeneous by vortexing

parameters.name: Next operation and timing
parameters.value_text: When the medium slurry is resuspended, immediately pipette the required amount of medium slurry into the desired tube

parameters.name: Resuspension between withdrawals
parameters.value_text: Repeat the resuspension step between each pipetting from the medium slurry vial

claims.statement: After adding liquid, resuspend the beads by vortexing or manual inversion of the tube.

parameters.name: Resuspension method
parameters.value_text: manual inversion of the tube after addition of liquid

claims.statement: When processing multiple samples, manual inversion of the magnetic rack is recommended for resuspension after adding liquid.
During incubation, make sure the magnetic beads are well resuspended and kept in solution by end-over-end mixing or a benchtop shaker.

parameters.name: Mixing method
parameters.value_text: using a benchtop shaker during incubation

claims.statement: Incubation steps generally take place at room temperature.
Incubation can take place at +4°C overnight if this is the recommended storage condition for the specific sample.

values: if this is the recommended storage condition for the specific sample
all_of.source_text: if this is the recommended storage condition for the specific sample

claims.statement: When purifying samples of low concentrations or large volumes, an increase of incubation time might be necessary.

all_of.source_text: When purifying samples of low concentrations

claims.statement: If needed, a pipette can be used to remove liquid from the lid.
Check the pH of the sample before applying it to the beads.
If necessary, adjust the sample pH before applying the sample to the beads. Adjustment could be done by diluting with binding buffer, or by buffer exchange using PD MiniTrap G-25 or HiTrap Desalting.

all_of.source_text: adjust if necessary before applying the sample to the beads

parameters.name: Adjustment alternative
parameters.value_text: diluting the sample with binding buffer

parameters.name: Adjustment alternative
parameters.value_text: buffer exchange using PD MiniTrap G-25

claims.statement: Clarification of the sample might be needed before applying it to the beads.

values: Clarification of sample might be needed
all_of.source_text: Clarification of sample might be needed before applying it to the beads.

claims.statement: The stated binding buffer is PBS: 137 mM sodium chloride, 2.7 mM potassium chloride, 100 mM sodium hydrogen phosphate and 2 mM potassium hydrogen phosphate, pH 7.4.
The stated elution buffer is 100 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.8.
The stated neutralizing buffer is 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 9.0.
Water and chemicals used for buffer preparation should be of high purity.
Filter buffers through a 0.45 μm filter before use.

parameters.name: Filter specification
parameters.value_text: through a 0.45 μm filter before use

claims.statement: Protocol steps 1–3: thoroughly mix the medium slurry by vortexing and dispense 100 µL homogeneous slurry into an Eppendorf tube; place the tube in a magnetic rack, for example MagRack 6; then remove the storage solution.

parameters.name: Step 1
parameters.value_text: Mix the medium slurry thoroughly by vortexing. Dispense 100 µL homogenous medium slurry into an Eppendorf tube.

parameters.name: Step 2
parameters.value_text: Place the Eppendorf tube in the magnetic rack, for example, MagRack 6.

claims.statement: Protocol steps 4–6: add 500 µL binding buffer, resuspend the medium, then remove the liquid.
Protocol step 7: immediately after equilibration, add 300 µL of sample.

parameters.name: Sample application volume and timing
parameters.value_text: Immediately after equilibration, add 300 µL of sample.

claims.statement: As specified in protocol step 7, if the sample volume is less than 300 µL, dilute it to 300 µL with binding buffer.

all_of.source_text: If the sample volume is less than 300 µL

parameters.name: Final diluted sample volume
parameters.value_text: dilute to 300 µL with binding buffer

claims.statement: Protocol steps 8–9: resuspend the medium and incubate for 30 min with slow end-over-end mixing or by using a benchtop shaker; then remove the liquid.

parameters.name: Compound instruction: sample application steps 8–9
parameters.value_text: Resuspend the medium and incubate for 30 min with slow end-over-end mixing or by using a benchtop shaker. Then Remove the liquid.

claims.statement: Perform the washing sequence in protocol steps 10–12 twice in total: add 500 µL binding buffer, resuspend the medium, then remove the liquid.

parameters.name: Compound washing instruction: two total cycles of steps 10–12
parameters.value_text: Washing (perform this step two times totally) Add 500 µL binding buffer. Resuspend the medium. Remove the liquid.

claims.statement: Protocol steps 13–15: add 100 µL elution buffer, resuspend the medium, then remove and collect the elution fraction.

parameters.name: Step 15, collection
parameters.value_text: Remove and collect the elution fraction.

claims.statement: The collected elution fraction contains the main part of the purified antibody.
If desired, repeat the elution.
As a safety measure to preserve the activity of acid-labile antibodies, addition of 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 9.0 to tubes used for collecting antibody-containing fractions is recommended.

purposes.text: As a safety measure to preserve the activity of acid-labile antibodies.

parameters.name: Collection-tube additive: stock concentration and pH (not an addition volume)
parameters.value_text: addition of 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 9.0 to tubes used for collecting antibody-containing fractions

claims.statement: The pH of the sample should equal the pH of the binding buffer.

parameters.name: Recommended sample pH target
parameters.value_text: The pH of the sample should equal the pH of the binding buffer.
